correctness.rationale: A simplex barycenter is fixed by σ exactly when barycentric weights agree on every color orbit; consequently the geometric fixed space is the independence complex of the color-orbit graph. If any singleton color orbit exists, a fixed-color vertex dominates each nontrivial orbit vertex over the same base graph vertex in the appropriate open-neighborhood order, permitting simplicial folds to G×K_f. Without singleton orbits, the graph is exactly G[bar K_t], t the number of cycles. The reduced Lefschetz character equals minus fixed-space reduced Euler characteristic because Antolín Camarena–Carnero Bravo prove degree 2ell-1 concentration. The independence polynomial at -1 for the clone blowup reduces to that of C_{3ell}, whose 2×2 transfer eigenvalues are exp(±iπ/3), giving derangement trace 2(-1)^ell. The augmentation permutation representation has character f-1, proving the formula. A newly separate recursive quotient independence-polynomial calculation checked 42 complete finite actions across ell 1,2,3, with no disagreement. No finite experiment is used as an all-ell proof.
